admission_rule.original_problem: Every value that changes the feasible set, objective, constraint, learning state, or physical FES must be machine readable or uniquely specified before R3.
admission_rule.reconstruction: A runnable reconstruction is allowed only under a different semantic identifier with every substituted input and inferred transition registered.
admission_rule.formal_comparison: Original-problem and reconstructed-proxy results must never be pooled.
admission_rule.hpc: R4 speed or scaling evidence is admissible only after the corresponding R1 and R2 semantic profile passes.
